text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! It's delicious!
It really warms you right up~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
King-chan's black tea really is the best!
I want to try brewing tea like this too~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Then why don't you give it a try?
I'll teach you how to brew it."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Thank youuu!
All right, Tsuyoshi's gonna do her best!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First, the water.
You bring it to a boil between 95 and 100 degrees.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And when brewing tea, make sure to warm the teapot beforehand so it doesn't cool down.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Boil the water and warm up the teapot!
Alright! I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...
A-All right... Everything's perfect so far...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there was anything that
would drain our stamina like that, though...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
I managed to brew it properly...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Now then, shall we give this a try?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?
It doesn't taste good.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Why!?
I brewed it just the way
King-chan told me to!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Where did I go wrong!?
Near the end!? Or right from the start!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, calm down.
Let's take our time and think it through, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll brew you some black tea once more.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew... King-chan's black tea
really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Besides, it's very calming.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Of course it is, considering I brewed it
with the sole wish of helping you calm down."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: While thinking "calm down"...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Black tea... Well, flavored tea to be precise, but
I brewed it thinking it would be perfect for you right now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Something perfectly suited to the person you are serving...
When it comes to black tea, your feelings toward your guest are what truly matter.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Feelings toward the other person...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
King-chan,
I want to brew black tea that helps fight off colds!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A cold...? Are you feeling unwell?
If so, I think ginger black tea would be good for you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while working in the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Would you like to take a short break with some black tea?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, did you know? Black tea is
something you brew while thinking of the other person!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And this black tea is for you, Trainer,
for always working so hard!
I hope it keeps you from catching a cold or anything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The black tea Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi brewed
was crisp, easy to drink, and above all, delicious.
choice_data_list: Awesome! Tsuyoshi, come have a drink with us too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You finished it so fast!
I'll brew you a refill right away!
choice_data_list: Should I savor it a bit more as I drink?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's fine! Drink lots of it and get healthy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh, me too!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I want Tsuyoshi to get healthy too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Thank you so much~!"
